manifest.name: dsh-web-api-balance
manifest.description: 在 Harness Web 界面显示 DeepSeek API 余额与本次对话消耗：输入框旁的常驻余额胶囊，悬停展开明细。
manifest.author: Charaaah

bundle.text:
# dsh-web-api-balance —— bundle patch
#
# 往 profile 配置树里插入一行插件。id 与包名保持一致，方便按 id 覆盖配置：
#
#   - id: dsh-web-api-balance
#     config:
#       apiKey: sk-xxxx            # 直接写 key（优先级最高）
#       apiKeyEnv: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY # 或写 key 的环境变量名，默认值就是它
#       baseURL: https://api.deepseek.com
#       refreshSeconds: 300
#
# 不写 config 时按 apiKey -> 环境变量/凭证服务里的 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 顺序回退，
# 所以「设置 → 模型」里已经存过 DeepSeek key 的话可以直接用。
- insert:
    - id: dsh-web-api-balance
      name: 'dsh-web-api-balance'
      inject: [webServer]
      config:
        apiKey: ''
        apiKeyEnv: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
        baseURL: https://api.deepseek.com
        refreshSeconds: 300

readme.text:
﻿# dsh-web-api-balance

[](LICENSE)
[](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

<!-- README-I18N:START -->

**中文** | [English](./README.en.md)

<!-- README-I18N:END -->

在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面里显示 DeepSeek API 余额，顺便算一下当前这条对话花了多少钱。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-web-api-balance@1.0.5
```

版本号建议钉死，升级时手动改。DSH 升级、或者这个仓库更新，都不会顺手把你装的插件换掉，这点是故意的。

npm 连不上就从 Release 装，同一个文件：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Charaaah/dsh-web-api-balance/releases/download/v1.0.5/dsh-web-api-balance-1.0.5.tgz
```

从源码装也可以。`dsh plugin` 认仓库 URL 和 `github:owner/repo` 简写（会先探一次 GitHub 连通性），
`#` 后面会被 pnpm 当 git ref，所以能钉到 commit：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Charaaah/dsh-web-api-balance
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Charaaah/dsh-web-api-balance#<commit-sha>
```

装完刷一下页面。如果你之前用 `link:` 或 `file:` 装过同一个版本号，直接 `add` 不会替换它，pnpm 会认为
版本已满足然后跳过，得先 remove。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-web-api-balance
```

这条是转发给 profile 目录里的 pnpm，所以会卸掉包和 `package.json` 里那行依赖。`dsh.profile.bundles`
不会跟着清。那是 DSH 的字段，pnpm 不认识，得自己编辑 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json` 把包名删掉：

```jsonc
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
  "dshmarket"

留着会指向一个不存在的包，启动时会报。市场页面的插件开关会帮你把这两步一起做，命令行不会。

下面几样卸载不管，需要的话自己清：

- `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` 里的 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`。这是 DSH 凭证服务的条目，「设置 → 模型」写进去的
  也是同一个，你可能在别处还在用，所以插件不动它。
- profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里手工写的那段 `- id: dsh-web-api-balance`。包没了以后这行会被忽略，
  但里面可能写着 `apiKey`。
- `localStorage` 的 `dsh-web-api-balance:last`，存的是金额和时间戳，没有凭证。

npm 上的版本删不掉（版本号不可变），所以卸载只影响本机，想装回来随时 `add` 一次就行。

只有一处 UI：输入框工具栏、发送键左边的常驻胶囊，显示总余额。鼠标移上去（或者键盘聚焦）弹出浮层，
左右两栏，中间一条竖线：

```
总余额      ¥15.00  │   本次对话消耗     梁文谷
充值余额    ¥13.50  │   缓存命中    1,000,000   ¥0.30
赠送余额     ¥1.50  │   缓存未命中  2,000,000   ¥18.00
更新时间    20:00:00│   输出          500,000   ¥13.50

左栏是账户余额，右栏是这条会话的消耗。没有用量报告时右栏和竖线一起消失，只剩单栏。两栏顶部对齐，
账户栏不必重复胶囊上已经有的名字，也没单独再打一遍总额，总额就是「总余额」那行。

胶囊本身切成两半，没有额外按钮也没有文字：

- 左半边是圆点加金额，点一下立即刷新。
- 右半边是一条 22px 的竖条加钱包加号图标，平时宽度 0、完全看不见，鼠标进胶囊才滑出来，点击在新标签页
  打开充值页。

静止状态下它就是个干净的数字。取不到余额时也没有金额可充，整个右半边不渲染，胶囊变红，浮层里写明
原因。

充值地址优先用账号服务给的 `AccountView.links.topUpUrl`，这样指向内部 Platform 的部署会跳自己的站点；
拿不到就用公开的 `https://platform.deepseek.com/top_up`。浏览器半侧内置了同一个兜底，宿主没报告
地址时右半边也能用。

余额走 DeepSeek 官方的 `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance`，登录了账号时走 DSH 自己的账号服务。

官方的 token 计数看不出花了多少钱，右栏就把这条会话的累计用量按人民币拆开，三个计费桶各一行：

| 行 | 取数 |
|---|---|
| 缓存命中 | `tokenUsage.cacheReadTokens` |
| 缓存未命中 | `tokenUsage.uncachedInputTokens` + `cacheWriteTokens` |
| 输出 | `tokenUsage.outputTokens` |
| 合计 | 上面三项之和 |

官方 schema 里 `prompt_tokens = prompt_cache_hit_tokens + prompt_cache_miss_tokens`，这三行能覆盖全部
计费 token。缓存本身不额外收费，落盘、存储、过期都不进账单，只有 token 按这三档计价。

用量是宿主从整条会话日志折出来的官方回报值，价格则按 `useProjection('modelSelection')` 里的当前路由查表。
两个投影都是宿主推的，有回报就更新，不用额外请求，也不往外发数据。

价格表是写死的，在 `client.js` 的 `PRICING` 里，单位元每百万 tokens。官方调价了改这一个对象。表里没有的
模型不猜，照样显示 token 数，金额位置写「未收录该模型价格」。旧名字 `deepseek-v4-flash` 和
`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` 按官方说明归到 `deepseek-flash`。

峰谷这块容易看错，多说两句。右栏标题右边那个名字就是当前档位：北京时间工作日 9:00–12:00 和 14:00–18:00
显示「梁文峰」，其余时间「梁文谷」，后者半价。判断是拿当前时刻先算成 UTC+8 再读时钟，浏览器在哪个
时区都一样。

两个已知的坑：一是我没做节假日，插件不带日历，法定假日的工作日会显示梁文峰、把价格算高。二是累计用量里
没有每次请求的时间戳，跨了峰谷的会话没法归到某一档，这个名字的意思只是「此刻发请求按哪档价」。

另外，flash 和 pro 不是一个价。单价从 modelSelection 投影的当前路由查，表里两套价分开（命中 ¥0.04 / ¥0.30，
未命中 ¥2 / ¥9，输出 ¥8 / ¥27，都是高峰价）。路由带不带 `deepseek-official/` 前缀都能对上。`next` 优先于
`lastUsed`，你刚在模型选择器里改过、下次请求才用的那个，显示的就是它。

数字是当前会话的累计，不含子代理（它们各自是独立会话），也不是账号的历史账单。要看账号侧的消耗去官方
平台的用量页。

还有一点：累计用量是一条会话一个总数，里面没记哪段用了哪个模型。一条会话中途从 flash 换成 pro，
整条会按当前模型的单价算。换过就是估值，没换过就是准的。会话切换时组件会重挂，用量是按每条会话的
日志分别折的，不会串。

一般不用填。宿主按这个顺序取，两条路都不用你手输：

1. 账号授权（`deepseekAccount.getBalance`）。就是「设置 → 账号」登录 DeepSeek 之后写入的那个 OAuth 授权，
   这条路上没有 API Key。
2. 已保存的 API Key。`config.apiKey` 优先，留空就去凭证服务里找 `config.apiKeyEnv` 指定的引用，默认
   `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`。这跟「设置 → 模型」填 DeepSeek key 时写进 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` 的是同一个
   条目，早就配过 key 的话直接就能读；启动 dsh 的进程环境里有同名变量也行。

两条都没有时胶囊显示「余额不可用」，浮层写具体原因，不会静默失败。浮层底部会标这次数字来自哪条路。

宿主半侧为什么必须有：余额接口不带 CORS 头，而且 API Key 不能进浏览器。`host.js` 因此拿着凭证发请求、
缓存结果，在 `/plugins/dsh-web-api-balance/balance` 上出一份 JSON（`?refresh=1` 强制实时查），`client.js`
只 fetch 这个同源路由。路由和页面其它请求走同一套会话令牌鉴权。

写在 web profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里 `id: dsh-web-api-balance` 那行。不配也能用：

```yaml
- id: dsh-web-api-balance
  disabled: false
  inject: [webServer]
  config:

顺序是账号授权 → `config.apiKey` → 凭证服务的 `apiKeyEnv` → 同名环境变量，谁先命中用谁。

宿主按 `refreshSeconds` 缓存，并发的读共用一次上游调用。账号授权那条走 DSH 自己的服务、不发外部 HTTP；
未登录（返回 `null`）时落到 API Key 那条。浏览器每 5 分钟自动刷一次，点胶囊立即刷。最近一次成功的摘要
存进 `localStorage`，页面刷新先显示旧值再更新。上游返 401/403 归为「key 无效」，不反复重试。

浮层只在悬停或聚焦时渲染，平时不占位，设了 `pointer-events: none` 不会挡住点击。「本次对话消耗」那栏
只在宿主报告过用量之后出现，新会话什么都没发时整栏连同竖线都不渲染。金额留两位小数，不够一分的留三位，
免得显示成 `¥0.00`。样式只用宿主主题令牌（`--dsw-alias-*`），浅色深色都跟随。

路由返回的 JSON 就是浏览器半侧渲染用的：

```jsonc
{
  "ok": true,
  "source": "account" | "api-key",  // 这次数字来自哪条凭证路
  "topUpUrl": "https://platform.deepseek.com/top_up",

包里没有凭证，也不往任何地方回传数据。代码里没有 API Key 字面量，key 只在运行时从插件配置、凭证服务
（`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`，DSH 自己维护）或启动进程的环境变量里读。它唯一的去处是 `Authorization:
Bearer` 头，目标就是余额接口本身（默认 `api.deepseek.com`），没有遥测、没有日志打印、没有第三方请求。
key 也不进浏览器，浏览器半侧只读同源路由返回的几个数字，唯一写本地的是 `localStorage` 里的余额摘要。

打包出来 14 个文件（`LICENSE`、`README.md`、`README.en.md`、`client.js`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`host.js`、
`icon.svg`、`index.js`、`locale/{en,zh}.json`、`package.json`、`release.json`、`assets/preview{,.en}.svg`），
两个测试脚本、构建脚本、任何 profile 状态和任何凭证都不在里面。Release 上的 tarball 和 npm 上的是同一条
`npm pack` 命令打出来的，两条安装路径装到的是同一份字节。

两个脚本，只依赖 Node 标准库，不需要 profile 的 node_modules：

```sh
node smoke-test.mjs   # 浏览器半侧
node host-test.mjs    # 宿主半侧
```

`smoke-test.mjs` 用桩模块加载器和带状态的 React 垫片加载 `client.js`，验槽位注册和字典解析，驱动胶囊走
「失败 → 悬停展开 → 点击刷新成功 → 明细齐全」，另外验右半边在无余额时不渲染、有余额时点击用正确的 URL
新开标签页、宿主没给地址时的兜底，以及消耗栏：没有用量时不渲染、三个桶的 token 数与金额逐项对上
`deepseek-v4-pro` 高峰价、合计正确、未知模型只报 token 不报金额、旧模型名走别名价。

`host-test.mjs` 起一个假的 DeepSeek `/user/balance`，把插件的路由挂到真实 HTTP 上跑通缓存命中、强制刷新、
401、环境变量回退、无凭证、账号授权优先、未登录回退到已存 key，以及充值地址。

发布脚本在 `publish/` 下，也不随包发布。这台机器没有 git，所以推仓库是走 GitHub REST API 的
blob → tree → commit → ref 四步，最后读回来校验：

```powershell
node publish/build-repo.mjs --owner Charaaah   # 生成 publish/repo/，补公开元数据和 release.json
node publish/pack-npm.mjs                      # npm pack --ignore-scripts，产物即发 npm 的那份
$env:DSH_GH_TOKEN = '<token>'                  # 只在当前会话里，不落盘
node publish/push-github.mjs --dry-run         # 先看计划

﻿# dsh-web-api-balance

[](LICENSE)
[](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

<!-- README-I18N:START -->

[中文](./README.md) | **English**

<!-- README-I18N:END -->

Shows your DeepSeek API balance inside the DeepSeek Harness web UI, and works out what the current
conversation has cost so far.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-web-api-balance@1.0.5
```

Pin the version. To upgrade, change the number and run it again. Updating DSH, or this repository, will
not swap the installed plugin for you, and that is deliberate.

If npm is unreachable, install from the release instead. It is the same file:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Charaaah/dsh-web-api-balance/releases/download/v1.0.5/dsh-web-api-balance-1.0.5.tgz
```

From source works too. `dsh plugin` accepts a repository URL and the `github:owner/repo` shorthand, and
both probe GitHub connectivity first. Everything after `#` is read by pnpm as a git ref, so a commit
can be pinned:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Charaaah/dsh-web-api-balance
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Charaaah/dsh-web-api-balance#<commit-sha>
```

Refresh the page afterwards. If you previously installed the same version with `link:` or `file:`, a
plain `add` will not replace it; pnpm sees the version satisfied and skips, so remove it first.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-web-api-balance
```

That forwards to pnpm inside the profile directory, so it drops the package and its dependency line.
`dsh.profile.bundles` is not cleaned, because that is a DSH field and pnpm does not know it exists.
Edit `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json` and remove the name yourself:

```jsonc
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
  "dshmarket"

Leaving it in names a package that is not installed, which breaks the boot. The market page's plugin
toggle does both steps; the command line does not.

An uninstall leaves these alone, so clear them by hand if you want them gone:

- `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` in `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`. That belongs to DSH's credential service and is
  the same entry the Models settings page writes, so you may still be using it elsewhere. The plugin
  neither creates nor deletes it.
- A hand-written `- id: dsh-web-api-balance` block in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. It is
  harmless once the package is gone, since a row whose package is absent is ignored, but it may hold
  an `apiKey`.
- The `localStorage` cache under the key `dsh-web-api-balance:last`, which holds amounts and a
  timestamp and no credential.

A published version cannot be withdrawn from the registry, since npm versions are immutable, so
uninstalling only affects this machine. `1.0.5` stays published and can be installed again at any time.

There is one thing: a persistent chip on the composer toolbar, to the left of the send button,
showing the total balance. Hovering it, or focusing it from the keyboard, opens a panel with two
columns and a vertical rule between them:

```
Total       ¥15.00  │   This session        off-peak
Topped up   ¥13.50  │   Cache hit    1,000,000   ¥0.30
Granted      ¥1.50  │   Cache miss   2,000,000   ¥18.00
Updated   20:00:00  │   Output         500,000   ¥13.50

The left column is the account balance, the right is this conversation's cost. With no usage reported
yet the right column and the rule both disappear and the panel falls back to a single column. The two
columns are top-aligned, so the account column does not repeat the name already on the chip and does
not print the total twice; the total is simply its own "Total" row.

The chip itself is split in half, with no extra buttons and no text:

- The left half, a dot and the amount, refreshes the balance immediately when clicked.
- The right half, a 22px strip with a wallet-plus icon, is zero-width and invisible until the pointer
  enters the chip. Clicking it opens the top-up page in a new tab.

So at rest it is just a clean number. When the balance can't be read there is nothing to top up, so
the whole right half is not rendered, the chip turns red, and the panel states the reason.

The top-up address prefers `AccountView.links.topUpUrl` from the account service, so a deployment
pointing at an internal Platform sends you to its own site. Failing that it uses the public
`https://platform.deepseek.com/top_up`. The browser half has the same fallback built in, so the right
half works even when the host reports no address.

The balance comes from DeepSeek's own `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance`, or from DSH's
account service when you are signed in.

readme.section: How the cost is worked out
readme.text:
The official token counts don't tell you what you spent, so the right column splits this session's
cumulative usage into money, one row per billing bucket, with a total at the end:

| Row | Source |
|---|---|
| Cache hit | `tokenUsage.cacheReadTokens` |
| Cache miss | `tokenUsage.uncachedInputTokens` + `cacheWriteTokens` |
| Output | `tokenUsage.outputTokens` |
| Total | the three above |

readme.section: How the cost is worked out
readme.text:
The official schema has `prompt_tokens = prompt_cache_hit_tokens + prompt_cache_miss_tokens`, so
those three rows cover every billable token. Caching itself costs nothing extra: writing, storing and
expiring the cache never appear on the bill, only the tokens, priced in those three tiers.

readme.section: How the cost is worked out
readme.text:
The numbers come from DSH's session projection: the usage the host folds out of the whole session log
from what the provider reported, not an estimate. The rate comes from the current route in
`useProjection('modelSelection')`. Both are pushed by the host, so the panel updates as soon as usage
is reported, with no extra request and nothing sent anywhere.

readme.section: How the cost is worked out
readme.text:
The rate table is hardcoded in `PRICING` inside `client.js`, in CNY per million tokens, so an official
price change means editing that one object. A model that is not in the table is not guessed at: the
token counts still show, and the amount reads "price not listed for this model". The retired ids
`deepseek-v4-flash` and `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` bill as `deepseek-flash`, per the official
notice.

readme.section: How the cost is worked out
readme.text:
Peak and off-peak is easy to misread, so it is worth spelling out. The name to the right of the column
heading is the tariff in effect: Beijing-time weekdays 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 read "梁文峰",
everything else "梁文谷", which is half price. The check converts the current instant to UTC+8 and reads
the clock, so the browser's own timezone does not matter.

readme.section: How the cost is worked out
readme.text:
Two caveats. There is no holiday handling, since the plugin ships no calendar, so a Chinese public
holiday on a weekday reads "梁文峰" and overstates the cost. And cumulative usage carries no per-request
timestamp, so a session that spans a tariff change cannot be assigned to one tier; the name only means
"the tariff a request sent right now would pay".

readme.section: How the cost is worked out
readme.text:
Also, flash and pro are not priced alike. The rate comes from the modelSelection projection's current
route, and the table keeps them separate (hit ¥0.04 / ¥0.30, miss ¥2 / ¥9, output ¥8 / ¥27, all peak). A
route matches with or without a `deepseek-official/` prefix. `next` outranks `lastUsed`, so a model you
just picked in the selector, the one the next request will use, is the one shown.

readme.section: How the cost is worked out
readme.text:
The numbers are this session's cumulative usage. Subagents are separate sessions with their own usage
and are not counted, and this is not your account's historical bill. For account-wide spend, use the
official platform's usage page.

readme.section: How the cost is worked out
readme.text:
One more thing: cumulative usage is a single total per session and does not record which model was used
for which part. So if a session switched from flash to pro partway through, the whole session is priced
at the current model's rate, which is accurate if nothing changed and an estimate if something did.
Switching sessions remounts the component, and usage is folded per session log, so nothing bleeds
across.

Usually there is nothing to fill in. The host resolves credentials in this order, and neither route
needs you to type anything:

1. Account grant, `deepseekAccount.getBalance`. The OAuth grant written when you sign in to DeepSeek
   under Settings → Account. This route has no API key at all.
2. A stored API key. `config.apiKey` wins if set; otherwise the credential-service reference named by
   `config.apiKeyEnv`, default `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. That is the very entry the DeepSeek key in
   Settings → Models writes to `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`, so if you configured a key before, the
   plugin simply reads it. A same-named variable in the launching process environment also works.

With neither present the chip reads "balance unavailable" and the panel gives the specific reason
instead of failing quietly. The panel footer notes which route the numbers came from
(`DeepSeek account` or `API key`).

The host-side half exists because the balance endpoint sends no CORS headers and an API key must never
reach browser code. So `host.js` holds the credential, makes the request and caches the result,
exposing a JSON summary at `/plugins/dsh-web-api-balance/balance` (`?refresh=1` forces a live query),
while `client.js` only fetches that same-origin route. The route goes through the same `dsh web` session
token as every other request the page makes.

Configuration lives in the web profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, on the `id: dsh-web-api-balance` row. It
works unconfigured; you only need this to override a default:

```yaml
- id: dsh-web-api-balance
  disabled: false
  inject: [webServer]
  config:

Resolution is account grant → `config.apiKey` → the credential service's `apiKeyEnv` → a same-named
environment variable, first hit wins.

The host caches for `refreshSeconds` and concurrent reads share one upstream call. The account-grant
route goes through DSH's own service and makes no external HTTP request; when it reports `null` for a
signed-out account the API-key route takes over. The browser refreshes every five minutes, and
clicking the chip refreshes immediately. The last successful summary is stored in `localStorage`, so a
page reload shows the old value before updating. An upstream 401 or 403 is classified as an invalid
key and not retried in a loop.

The panel renders only while hovered or focused and does not occupy space otherwise; it also sets
`pointer-events: none` so it never blocks a click. The "this session" column appears only once the
host has reported usage, so a new session with no messages yet renders neither the column nor the
rule. Amounts keep two decimals, except a bucket under one fen, which keeps three so it does not read
`¥0.00`. Styling uses host theme tokens only (`--dsw-alias-*`), so light and dark both follow.

The JSON shape the route returns, which is what the browser half renders:

```jsonc
{
  "ok": true,
  "source": "account" | "api-key",  // which credential route these numbers came from
  "topUpUrl": "https://platform.deepseek.com/top_up",

The package contains no credential and sends nothing anywhere. There is no API key literal in the
code; a key is read at runtime from the plugin config, the credential service
(`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`, maintained by DSH) or the launching process environment. Its only
destination is the `Authorization: Bearer` header aimed at the balance endpoint itself, by default
`api.deepseek.com`. No telemetry, no logging of it, no third-party request. It is never sent to the
browser either; the browser half only reads a few numbers from a local same-origin route, and the only
thing it writes locally is the balance summary in `localStorage` (amounts and a timestamp).

The package holds 14 files: `LICENSE`, `README.md`, `README.en.md`, `client.js`, `cordis.patch.yml`,
`host.js`, `icon.svg`, `index.js`, `locale/{en,zh}.json`, `package.json`, `release.json` and
`assets/preview{,.en}.svg`. The two test scripts, the build scripts, any profile state and any
credential are not among them. The release tarball and the npm tarball come from the same
`npm pack` command, so both install routes deliver the same bytes.

Two scripts live in the repository and depend only on the Node standard library, with no need for the
profile's `node_modules`:

```sh
node smoke-test.mjs   # browser half
node host-test.mjs    # host half
```

`smoke-test.mjs` loads `client.js` against a stubbed module loader and a stateful React shim, asserts
slot registration and dictionary resolution, and drives the chip through failure → hover → successful
refresh → full detail. It also asserts that the right half does not render without a balance, that
clicking it with a balance opens the correct URL, the fallback when the host reports no address, and
the cost column: absent without usage, with the three buckets' token counts and amounts matching
`deepseek-v4-pro` peak rates, a correct total, no amount for an unknown model, and alias pricing for
retired model names.

`host-test.mjs` starts a fake DeepSeek `/user/balance` endpoint and mounts the plugin's route on real
HTTP, covering a cache hit, a forced refresh, 401, environment fallback, no credential, the account
grant taking precedence, the fallback to a stored key when signed out, and the top-up address.

has no git, so pushing goes through the GitHub REST API: blob, tree, commit, ref, then a read-back of
the repository to verify.
